## Summary

A short, one-line description of the feature you are requesting.

## Problem or motivation

Describe the problem this feature would solve, or the use case that motivates it.

## Proposed solution

Describe how you would like this to work. Include any relevant UI or behaviour details.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternatives you considered, and why they are less suitable.

## Additional context

Any other relevant information, mockups, or references.
